scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @arbestra/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @arbestra/api build && corepack pnpm --filter @arbestra/play-web build && corepack pnpm --filter @arbestra/world-web build
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @arbestra/contracts build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @arbestra/api --filter @arbestra/play-web --filter @arbestra/world-web dev
scripts.db:setup: corepack pnpm db:migrate && corepack pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:test:setup: corepack pnpm db:migrate:test && corepack pnpm --filter @arbestra/api db:reset-e2e
scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm --filter @arbestra/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @arbestra/api build && playwright test
scripts.verify:db: corepack pnpm db:test:setup && corepack pnpm test
